config.label: A Cookie header from an already-signed-in portal session ("sessionid=
config.description: A Cookie header from an already-signed-in portal session ("sessionid=...; csrftoken=..."). Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.

config.label: Your portal
config.description: Your portal.crowntowncompost.com username or email address. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.

config.label: Your Crown Town Compost customer-portal password
config.description: Your Crown Town Compost customer-portal password. Needed only if you are not supplying CROWNTOWN_SESSION_COOKIE.

config.label: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start
config.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

config.label: Absolute path for the session cache file
config.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.crowntowncompost-mcp/session.json.
